TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT XRF.BUSINESS_NM as BUSINESS_NM , SYS.SYS_NM AS SYSTEM_NM , XRF.CONSOLIDATION_ID as CONSOLIDATION_ID , UPPER(XRF.MASTER_FL) as MASTER_FL FROM feladm.FEL_MASTER_DIM_XRF XRF INNER JOIN FELADM.FEL_SYSTEM_DIM SYS ON SYS.SYS_ID = XRF.SYSTEM_ID

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT xrf.CONSOLIDATION_ID as CONSOLIDATION_ID , XRF.DATA_TYP_ID as DATA_TYP_ID , XRF.SYSTEM_ID as SYSTEM_ID , upper(trim(XRF.BUSINESS_ID)) as BUSINESS_ID FROM feladm.FEL_MASTER_DIM_XRF xrf

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup condition
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: DATA_TYP_ID = in_DATA_TYP_ID AND SYSTEM_ID = in_SYSTEM_ID AND BUSINESS_ID = in_BUSINESS_ID
